raw.title: 2026 07 25 core 34 arazzo 1.1.0 spec
raw.body:
- **docs(specs): core-34 Arazzo 1.1.0 spec support design**
- **docs(plans): core-34 Arazzo 1.1.0 spec implementation plan**
- **feat(dto): add SpecVersion, ExpressionType, Querystring, Invoke enums**
- **feat(dto): add Selector value object for Arazzo 1.1.0 outputs/parameters**
- **feat(dto): ArazzoDocument gains $specVersion and $self for 1.1.0**
- **feat(dto): SubWorkflow{Success,Failure}Action for 1.1.0 composition**
- **feat(parser): strict version guard (1.0.x/1.1.x) + root $self + Querystring accept**
- **feat(parser): parse Arazzo 1.1.0 Selector objects in outputs map**
- **fix(parser): update step and workflow DTO phpdoc for outputs array types**
- **feat(parser): allow Selector objects in Parameter and PayloadReplacement values**
- **fix(execution): throw RuntimeException for unsupported Selector evaluation**
- **feat(parser): parse invoke actions (onSuccess/onFailure)**
- **fix(parser): phpstan types for parameters**
- **fix(parser): add version parsing to invoke actions**
- **feat(validator): extend version and parameter rules for 1.1.0**
- **fix(validator): add component parameters check for querystring in 1.1.0**
- **feat(validator): 5 new rules for 1.1.0 (selector, invoke, querystring, $self, asyncapi-11-gate)**
- **fix(validator): check selectors and actions in components**
- **feat(validator): expression-ref rules now analyse Selector context+selector**
- **fix(validator): don't evaluate Selector::selector as Arazzo expression, tighten test assertion**
- **feat(resolution): XpathEvaluator interface + DomXpathEvaluator (xpath-10)**
- **fix(resolution): xpathRequiresXml accept pointer parameter**
- **feat(resolution): SelectorEvaluator routes by ExpressionType**
- **fix(resolution): remove invalid XPath coercion**
- **feat(executor): SubWorkflowInvoker + child WorkflowContext + result DTO**
- **fix(executor): map ExecutionResult status instead of terminal, add tests**
- **feat(executor): Selector outputs, SubWorkflow routing, AsyncAPI SpecVersion branch**
- **feat(laravel): bind XpathEvaluator to DomXpathEvaluator; require ext-dom**
- **test(arazzo-1.1): comprehensive + per-feature fixtures + E2E parse/validate**
- **docs(changelog): Arazzo 1.1.0 substrate landed**
- **docs(ship): ship core-34-arazzo-1.1.0-spec**
